tasks.short: Comfort patients during MRI exams or request medication from physicians for anxiety or claustrophobia.

steps.what: Comfort the actual patient during the MRI exam, listen to anxiety or claustrophobia concerns and provide human support
outputs: actual comfort measures and continuing patient concerns

steps.what: Retrieve current patient and exam context and the responsible physician's contact where a medication request is needed
inputs: actual comfort measures and continuing patient concerns
outputs: checked current context and physician destination

steps.what: Prepare the actual request for physician assessment of sedatives or other medication using patient, exam and anxiety facts
inputs: checked current context and physician destination
actual comfort measures and continuing patient concerns
outputs: complete physician assessment request and actual facts

steps.what: Approve the finished request, actual patient facts and exact internal physician recipient
inputs: complete physician assessment request and actual facts
outputs: approved physician request version

steps.what: Send the approved assessment request to the named internal physician
outputs: sent internal physician assessment request

steps.what: Clarify the physician's actual response and continue human patient support under existing care practice
inputs: actual comfort measures and continuing patient concerns
outputs: actual response received and subsequent patient support

steps.what: Prepare the actual comfort and request note including patient response, report time and physician response
inputs: actual response received and subsequent patient support
actual comfort measures and continuing patient concerns
outputs: complete actual comfort and request note

steps.what: Approve the final actual comfort/request note and exact patient chart destination
inputs: complete actual comfort and request note
outputs: approved actual comfort note version

steps.what: Commit the approved actual comfort and request note to the internal patient record
outputs: signed actual comfort and request entry

tasks.design: Configure native patient/exam context and request templates in {OTHER}, the radiology and electronic patient record system. {CHAT} is the existing secure internal clinical messenger. Reassurance and actual patient support remain human. A request for physician assessment is prepared, checked and separately sent; no drug or dose is selected by software. Actual physician response and support are captured afterward, then the finished note is approved before a distinct chart commit. Changes void approval. Urgent direct contact remains human within existing practice. No model is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient/exam context is repeatedly copied into assessment requests and notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient-context fields and secure approved request routing.
tasks.still_hard: Actual anxiety, trust and clinical decisions about medication.
tasks.human_edge: Respond calmly to the patient's actual distress.

ambition.what: Reduce administration around human reassurance and physician requests.

tasks.altitude: Comfort and clinical judgement stay human.

reach.learn: Receive actual symptoms and support attempted, not a software prescription.

evidence.claim: Native clinical record fields and secure internal request templates can reuse patient and exam context.

assumptions: Shares are provisional across comfort-only and request cases; request-related shares are aggregate allocations, not required steps for every patient.

s2 includes manually checking actual patient ID, exam and physician destination; s3 manually captures actual anxiety concern, comfort measures and reason for assessment where no reusable fields exist.

The physician is internal to the care organization. Their existing assessment and prescribing work is not reduced or newly transferred by this design. External physician contact needs an external-action classification.

s7 manually captures actual response and event time. A sent request is not an order or proof of medication administration. Urgent direct escalation stays full human work and is never delayed by a draft workflow.
unknowns: Actual request frequency and native secure message support.
research_questions: Does request preparation improve after actual fact capture and review?

already_counted.description: Actual request preparation, final request review and actual note capture/review.

incremental.description: Maintain approved context fields and physician routing.

approvals.approved_version: exact final physician assessment request, actual patient facts and internal physician destination
actual completed comfort/request note and exact patient chart location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: three context, three request preparation and five actual physician-send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native patient context and routing remove all new benefit. Same-patient-record commitment, comfort and physician-response discussion retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain MRI procedures to patients, representatives or family members.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual ordered MRI procedure context and current approved patient explanation material
outputs: checked procedure explanation references

steps.what: Explain the MRI procedure personally to the patient, representative or family and answer actual questions
inputs: actual patient's questions and communication needs
outputs: actual explanation and questions addressed

steps.what: Check actual understanding, clarify misunderstandings and identify unresolved questions needing human follow-up
outputs: actual understanding and unresolved questions

steps.what: Prepare the actual explanation note with material used, recipient, communication needs and unresolved questions
outputs: complete actual MRI explanation note

steps.what: Approve the finished actual explanation note and exact patient chart destination
outputs: approved MRI explanation note version

steps.what: Commit the approved actual explanation note to the internal patient record
outputs: signed actual MRI explanation entry

tasks.design: Configure native links from the ordered exam in {OTHER}, the radiology/patient record system, to current approved explanation material in {DOCS}. The technologist checks the actual procedure and explains it personally, including understanding checks. Actual explanation notes are manually prepared after the conversation, approved in their final form and separately committed. Changes void approval. No model-generated patient instruction, automatic comprehension claim or unrepresented patient message is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct current procedure information adds preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exam-to-document links and controlled note filing.
tasks.still_hard: Actual understanding, language needs and sensitive family questions.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the explanation to the patient's real concerns.

ambition.what: Reduce reference handling around human MRI explanation.

reach.learn: Distinguish information delivered from actual understanding checked.

evidence.claim: Native patient-record links can retrieve current approved procedure information.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s1 includes manually checking exam type, patient context and information version when links fail.
s4 manually captures actual explanation recipient, material/version, questions and understanding limits; no completed note or consent is inferred from an information link.

The explanation note is assumed current required work; remove its baseline and benefit if no note is required. Sedation-request and anxiety-support work is task 23975 and must be allocated once when combined.
Any actual written patient follow-up or referral is separately drafted, approved and sent; no such action or saving is claimed here.
unknowns: Actual document retrieval time and note requirement.
research_questions: Does native reference linking reduce effort without shortening explanation?

already_counted.description: Actual explanation-note capture and final record review.

approvals.approved_version: exact actual MRI explanation note and patient chart destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four procedure-reference hours saved less half an hour upkeep. Low: native references already work and upkeep remains. Same-patient-record commitment, explanation and understanding checks retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct inventories to maintain clinical supply stock.

steps.what: Retrieve the current clinical supply item list, stock locations and established replenishment levels
inputs: existing supply item and stock-location records
outputs: checked inventory list and count locations

steps.what: Physically count actual clinical supplies and inspect package condition, lot and expiry where relevant
inputs: checked inventory list and count locations
outputs: actual stock count, expiry and condition observations

steps.what: Capture the actual count in a native inventory draft with item, location, quantity, lot and observed exceptions
inputs: actual stock count, expiry and condition observations
outputs: actual inventory count draft

steps.what: Compare actual counts with stock records and replenishment levels and resolve discrepancies
outputs: reconciled actual stock and proposed replenishment quantities

steps.what: Prepare the actual count adjustment and internal stores replenishment request with quantities and exceptions
inputs: reconciled actual stock and proposed replenishment quantities
outputs: complete actual count update and internal replenishment message

steps.what: Approve the finished actual count changes, replenishment request and exact internal stores destination
inputs: complete actual count update and internal replenishment message
outputs: approved inventory and replenishment package

steps.what: Commit the approved actual count adjustment to the internal inventory record
outputs: versioned actual clinical supply inventory

steps.what: Send the approved replenishment message to internal clinical stores
outputs: sent internal clinical stores request

tasks.design: Configure count lists, quantity fields and fixed replenishment comparisons in {ERP} and {OTHER}, the existing stock-count handheld or inventory screen. Physical counting and actual lot/expiry checks stay human. Native fields reduce repeated identifiers, not actual capture. The technician prepares the finished count adjustment and {EMAIL} stores request, approves both, then uses separate internal inventory commit and send steps. Changes void approval. A request does not prove supplies arrived; no supplier order, restock receipt or payment is inferred. No model is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Count lists, actual stock values and replenishment messages are repeatedly copied.
tasks.enabler_now: Native inventory count forms and fixed min/max comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden stock, damaged packs and actual expiry discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: Check that recorded usable stock exists physically.

ambition.what: Reduce inventory administration around actual counts.

reach.learn: Use actual counted usable quantities and recorded exceptions.

evidence.claim: Native inventory forms and min/max rules can prepare count comparisons and replenishment requests.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s2 retains all actual count and condition work. s3 manually captures actual item, location, quantity, lot, expiry and condition; scanning and missing identifier entry are human time.
s4 includes recounting or checking missing values and unit-of-pack differences. A planned stock list is not actual on-hand evidence.

s5 manually captures actual adjustment and request quantities. This task ends at the inventory record and internal request; physical store fulfillment and actual restocking remain existing downstream work with no saving credited or new capture burden shifted to others.
unknowns: Native count-list coverage and pack-unit consistency.
research_questions: Does inventory entry improve after all actual count and discrepancy time?

already_counted.description: Actual count entry, discrepancy checking and final request preparation/review.

incremental.description: Maintain item/location mappings and replenishment levels.

approvals.approved_version: exact actual clinical supply count changes and internal inventory destination
exact final replenishment message and internal clinical stores recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four list retrieval, three count-entry, five comparison and two actual stores-send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native stock features remove all new benefit. Same-inventory-record commitment and physical count retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

actual patient availability and access needs

steps.what: Find feasible MRI appointment slots using native scanner, duration, staffing and approved visit constraints

actual current scanner and staffing availability

tasks.design: Configure native MRI slot filters and appointment templates in {OTHER}, the radiology scheduling system, with {CALENDAR} availability and {EMAIL} confirmation. Actual intake, scheduling requirements and patient coordination remain human. Complete and approve the exact booking and confirmation before separate internal commit and external send. A slot conflict blocks both; any changed slot, instruction or recipient requires a new draft and approval. No clinical suitability decision, protocol choice, automatic reschedule or model is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feasible-slot searches and repeated appointment fields add scheduling work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scanner/resource constraints and standard confirmation templates.
tasks.still_hard: Missing requirements, patient access needs and conflicting resources.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve the actual patient's needs without silently changing clinical requirements.
tasks.altitude: Scheduling coordination remains accountable human work.

reach.learn: Send confirmation only for the exact approved successfully committed slot.

evidence.claim: Native radiology schedulers can filter resource slots and reuse appointment fields in confirmations.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s1 manually captures patient/subject ID, exam request, authorized duration/constraints, availability, contact and access needs, including missing-information clarification. No ready structured intake is assumed.
Existing clinical or research authorization supplies scheduling requirements; new clinical assessment or protocol approval is separate work with no saving credited.
s2 includes manual resource checks where calendars are incomplete. s4 includes actual instruction/version and destination entry and checking.

Native atomic booking or equivalent availability checks must block stale slots. Confirmation content is approved before commit and sends only for the identical successful booking; changed details require renewed approval.
unknowns: Native scanner constraint coverage and stale-slot handling.
research_questions: How much scheduling effort remains after actual intake and resource exceptions?
